title: Describing people
descriptionFa: قد و وزن، مو و صورت، قیافه و سن، و پرسیدن درباره‌ی ظاهر کسی.

words.example: What is your height in centimetres?
words.tipFa: تلفظ: «هایت». سؤال رایجش: How tall are you?

words.example: The nurse checked my height and weight.
words.tipFa: تلفظ: «ویت»، gh خونده نمی‌شه. سؤال رایجش: How much do you weigh?

words.example: Basketball players are usually very tall.
words.tipFa: برای آدم tall می‌گیم، نه high: He is tall.

words.example: My grandmother is short, only 1.50 metres.
words.tipFa: برای مو هم به کار می‌ره: short hair.

words.example: The thief was a man of medium height.
words.tipFa: معمولاً با of می‌گیم: He is of medium height.

words.example: She does yoga every day and she is very slim.
words.tipFa: slim مؤدبانه و مثبته؛ thin گاهی یعنی «زیادی لاغر».

words.example: He was very thin after his illness.
The doctor said my uncle is a little overweight.
Our cat is very fat because it eats all day.
words.tipFa: به خود آدم‌ها نگو You are fat؛ بی‌ادبانه‌ست.

words.example: Most people in my family have dark hair.
words.tipFa: She is dark یعنی مو و پوستش تیره‌ست.

words.example: Babies with fair skin need extra sun cream.
Her little brother has blonde hair and blue eyes.
words.tipFa: برای مرد گاهی blond (بدون e) می‌نویسن.

words.example: My father has had a beard since he was thirty.
In old photos, my grandfather has a big moustache.
The bride looked beautiful in her white dress.

words.meaningFa: خوشگل، بانمک (بیشتر برای دختر و زن)
words.example: What a pretty little girl!
words.tipFa: برای مردها pretty نمی‌گیم؛ good-looking یا handsome می‌گیم.

words.example: Her husband is tall and good-looking.
words.tipFa: برای زن و مرد هر دو به کار می‌ره.

words.example: I think this building is really ugly.
words.tipFa: درباره‌ی آدم‌ها خیلی تنده؛ بهتره نگی.

words.example: He isn't handsome or ugly. He's just average-looking.
My aunt is still young. She's only twenty-five.
A middle-aged man was waiting at the bus stop.
The old man walked slowly with a stick.
words.tipFa: old برای سن هم هست: How old are you? I'm 20 years old.

words.example: My mother works at a home for elderly people.

words.meaningFa: (از نظر ظاهر) شبیه بودن، چه شکلی بودن
words.example: What does your best friend look like?
words.tipFa: What does she look like? یعنی «چه شکلیه؟». جواب: She's tall and dark. She looks like her mother یعنی «شبیه مادرشه».
